purpose: Early full-game headroom budgets. These are integration gates, not T68/T69 physical-device certification.

global_soft_budgets.cpu_gpu_total_headroom_note: Keep >=20% scheduling/thermal headroom before final physical certification.

task_gate_policy.G8: A candidate fails when it exceeds an assigned hard budget, causes a material regression versus its base, or leaves required metrics missing.
task_gate_policy.soft_budget_exceedance: Requires integration-owner disposition with measured evidence and compensating headroom; cannot be waived by visual score.
task_gate_policy.final_physical_certification: Only T68/T69 can certify sustained native 4K/60 on representative physical hardware.

T03_current.note: Current capture evidence is not physical FPS evidence.
